source.name: Academic witness of a traditional educational supplication (not Prophetic attribution)
source.notice: Emine Cakmak (2013) Marmara University master thesis printed p.70 documents a prayer recited before traditional religious lessons. This witnesses the wording in educational practice, NOT authorship, Quranic/Prophetic origin, clinical memory improvement or medical effectiveness. Only the brief Arabic prayer phrase is included.

prayers.title: Hafızayı güçlendiren dua
prayers.reference: Emine Çakmak, Süleymancılık Cemaatinde Dini Eğitim Metotları (2013), p.70
prayers.arabic: اللهم ارزقنا حفظ المرسلين و الهام الانبياء و فهم الاولياء بكرمك يا اكرم الاكرمين و برحمتك يا ارحم الراحمين
